performance.label: Performance
performance.recovery_margin_help: After a warning, the check recovers only when the 60-minute median is this much below the limit for 3 samples in a row. Default: 5%.
performance.recovery_band: 60-min median :median ms. Recovers only below :recovery_below ms.
performance.no_data_while_down: No response-time data while the site is down (since :date)
performance.threshold_help: The absolute threshold applies to the last 60-minute median, not the displayed mean.
performance.minimum_increase_help: A warning needs the 60-minute median above the greater of the same UTC hour's seven-day p90 and its median increased by this percentage; a speed-up note needs it this percentage below that median. Both need a difference of at least 200 ms. Default: 50%.
performance.median_above_configured_rang: 60-min median :median ms exceeds :relative_threshold ms (max of p90 and +:minimum_increase%); +:delta ms vs usual :baseline ms. Average :average ms.
performance.slow: Average response time exceeds the threshold (:average ms).
performance.increased_with_baseline: Average :average ms, :change% above the previous 15-minute baseline of :baseline ms (threshold +:threshold%)
performance.above_threshold: Average :average ms exceeds the threshold of :threshold ms
performance.p95_pending: The hourly p95 appears once hourly uptime data exists.
performance.p95_definition: Within each hour, 95% of uptime observations are at or below this response time.
performance.p95_uptime: p95 of uptime response times, hourly
performance.confirming_warning: Average :average ms; elevated response time sample :count of 3 before a warning.
performance.confirming_recovery: Average :average ms; good response time sample :count of 3 before the warning clears.
